headline: On last trading session, Sensex and Nifty recorded their biggest weekly gains in six years during Diwali rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: FIIs returned to Indian stock markets, driving strong inflows into equities.
Festive buying enthusiasm surrounded the onset of Diwali and Samvat 2083.
Indian equities bucked the global tech rout and selloffs seen in Asian and US markets.
Strong domestic sentiment supported Sensex crossing major key resistance levels.
whatHappening: In the last session, Sensex rallied over 1,700 points to cross the 81,000 level.
Nifty 50 and Sensex capped off a weekly wrap jumping nearly 9% for the week.
Markets prepare to enter Samvat 2083 with Nifty trading above the 25,000 mark.
The Indian equity market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices delivered their best weekly performance in six years driven by Diwali rally optimism. Sensex surged over 1,700 points to top 81,000 as strong foreign institutional inflows returned to domestic equities. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.
